method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the Agency's report duty (s 8A(1), (3)) is a regulative rule with WITHIN and LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE, publication (s 8A(5)) a MUST with no WITHIN, and my answer to the CEO (s 14A(5)) a MAY; no REFUSE (gaps answer NOTHING, asserted); every belief, satisfaction or agreement of the CEO or the Minister asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. First encoding of the Act. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
